### Education

- MSc in Information Studies, Nanyang Technological University, 2018
- Bachelor of Information Technology, University of Wollongong, 2015
- Diploma in Information Technology, Singapore Polytechnic, 2011

### Work experience

#### **Singapore Management University**, Singapore  

**Senior Librarian, Research & Data Services** *(April 2024 - Present)*  
**Data Services Librarian** *(June 2021 - March 2024)*

- Provide research and data support to the SMU community across the research lifecycle, with a focus on data collection, analysis, reproducible workflows, and research communication.
- Design and deliver coding-for-research workshops in Python and R, with consistently positive participant feedback (>86% of participants would recommend the workshops to others).
- Develop and support research-facing initiatives on AI-enabled research workflows, including AI-powered search, literature discovery, transcription, and responsible use of emerging tools.
- Led and coordinated SMU Libraries’ inaugural AI hackathon in 2023, which resulted in a research project to implement the winning prototype.
- Founding member of the SMU Researcher Club, an initiative that engages research staff at SMU and fosters collaboration, knowledge sharing, and community-building among researchers.

#### **Nanyang Technological University**, Singapore  

**Librarian** *(February 2019 - June 2021)*  
**Assistant Librarian** *(August 2015 - January 2019)*

- Designed and developed more than 30 information and digital literacy classes for undergraduates and postgraduates. On average, the classes received a 95% satisfaction rating based on student feedback.
- Led a User Experience (UX) research project evaluating the usability of the Library’s discovery platform and Subject Guides.
- Developed and executed social media campaigns with the outreach team to promote the Library’s resources. The campaigns generated a 98% increase in followers for NTU Library’s Instagram account in one year.
- Developed a final year project (FYP) collection database for the Wee Kim Wee School of Communication and Information (WKWSCI), in collaboration with the communication subject librarian.
- Helped expand collaboration with NTU faculty to create and customise at least 100 course blogs and research websites supporting the university’s teaching and research activities.

**Library Executive** *(January 2013 - July 2015)*

- Contributed to the migration of blogs@NTU from in-house hosting to a cloud-hosted solution; drafted ITQ technical requirements, conducted vendor evaluation, and developed and executed the change communication plan.
- Developed WordPress self-help guides and conducted at least 10 customised WordPress workshops for NTU faculty, staff, and students.
- Provided technical customisation services and consultations for blogs@NTU projects.

#### **Tyler Projects Pte Ltd**, Singapore  

**Game Developer** *(September 2011 - December 2012)*

- Worked as part of a small agile team of three developers on the Facebook game *Social Life*.
- Developed integration with players’ Facebook accounts using the Facebook API.
- Developed parts of the gameplay mechanics using ActionScript 3, PHP, and JavaScript.
- Developed frontend user interface components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Designed and developed the tutorial section of the game to introduce and guide new players.

### Skills

- **Programming and technical skills:** Python, R, SQL, PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS.
- **Research and data services:** research data lifecycle support, data collection and analysis, reproducible research workflows, and research methods in the social sciences.
- **AI-enabled research workflows:** AI-powered search, literature discovery, transcription workflows, and practical evaluation of emerging research tools.
- **Teaching and facilitation:** workshop design, coding-for-research instruction, lesson planning, and hands-on technical training.
- **Tools and platforms:** GitHub, Quarto, WordPress, LibGuides.
- **Academic library practice:** liaison librarianship, library instruction, scholarly communication, researcher engagement, and open scholarship.
